title: Chemistry-Informed Dual-Expert Learning for Predicting Ozone-Pollutant Reaction Kinetics
description: DECAT provides training code, a Streamlit prediction app, the 1,626-record study dataset with references, processed model inputs, and pretrained weights for predicting ozone-pollutant reaction rate constants. Code is distributed under the MIT License. Data and model weights are covered by LICENSE-DATA-MODEL-RESEARCH-USE.txt; third-party materials retain their own terms.
